steps.en: System finds an alternative address from its own records
steps.id: Sistem menemukan alamat alternatif dari data sendiri
steps.why_en: It only covers foreigners, ignores appeals, and the job is switched off in production settings in the repository.
steps.why_id: Hanya untuk foreigner, tidak melihat appeal, dan job-nya dimatikan di pengaturan production dalam repo.

steps.en: System creates a work item with ID, notices and appeal details
steps.id: Sistem membuat work item berisi ID, notice, dan detail appeal
steps.why_en: Work item creation is only a placeholder that writes a log line.
steps.why_id: Pembuatan work item hanya placeholder yang menulis baris log.

steps.en: The work item shows the address given in the appeal
steps.id: Work item menampilkan alamat yang diberikan di appeal
steps.why_en: No appeal address exists in the system to show.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada alamat dari appeal di sistem untuk ditampilkan.

steps.en: The work item shows up on the officer's dashboard
steps.id: Work item muncul di dashboard officer
steps.why_en: A menu entry exists but no page, no routing to officers, and no backend for this work item.
steps.why_id: Ada entri menu tetapi tanpa halaman, tanpa pengarahan ke officer, dan tanpa backend untuk work item ini.
